contexts.text: Silver = spiritual truth. AC 6432:2.
For iron silver () = for natural truth spiritual truth. AC 1551:2. AE 176:3.
The inmost Spiritual they likened to silver.
Silver and gold () = spiritual and celestial things of faith.
Rays of silvern light (with) those in affections of truth.
(Abram rich) in silver () = the truths with which the Lord was enriched.
The Most Ancients compared... the truths thence to silver.
That silver, wherever mentioned, = truth; and, in the opposite, falsity. Illustrated.
He that hath no silver () = one in ignorance of truth, yet in the good of charity, like many within and without the Church.
Like silver purified seven times () = Divine truth. AE 257:5.
Gods of silver = falsities.
He that is bought with silver () = the spiritual... For silver = truth, thus what is spiritual of faith. AC 2114.
A thousand of silver () = an infinite abundance of rational truth. AC 2576:7.
In full silver () = redemption through truth. Explained. AC 2945. AC 2954. AC 2959. AC 2966.
Breast and arms of silver () = the second state of the Church, which was spiritual, because of charity. ( = spiritual good. AC 9406-7.) ( = truth from good. AC 10030:3.) AE 176:2.
To drink waters for silver () = to attribute truth to self. AE 654:61.
Under Gold, see this reference. AC 3154:2, etc., etc.
Molten image of their silver () = good falsified. ( = falsity ex quo. AE 1186:2.)
Hath devoured our silver () = consume the truth of these affections of truth. Explained.
If silver is mentioned in the Word, there is meant the truth which is of intelligence and of faith.
The silver hid in the earth () = the truth which is of faith (as used by one in faith without charity).
To restore their silver () = without any power of theirs; for to buy with silver = to procure for one's self from what is one's own. AC 5496.
Every one's bundle of his silver () = the ordinations of truths given gratis.
Take double silver () = truth received (over again). Explained.
Our silver in its weight () = truths according to the state of each.
When there is speech about truth, what is silvern appears there.
With those who are in truth from truth, such things appear of silver.
Other silver () = other truth. Explained.
a. Your silver came to me () = it seems like truth procured by them.
Put everyone's silver in his sack's mouth () = truth anew in the exterior Natural.
My silver cup () = interior truth.
And the silver of his corn (id) = the truth of good.
To Benjamin he gave 300 of silver () = what is full of truth from good.
Joseph collected all the silver () = all the true and adaptable Scientific. AC 6115. AC 6116. AC 6119. AC 6122.
Vessels of silver () = scientifics of truth. AC 7770.
A purchase of silver () = one who has some spiritual truth.
Silver = truth from good.
Free without silver () = without truth conjoined with it.
He is his silver () = truth acquired from proprium. Explained.
30 shekels of silver () = restitution to the full through truth.
He shall render silver () = (amendment) through truth. Explained. AE 537:7.
They shall divide the silver () = that its truth will be dispersed. Explained.
Silver = truth of good; in the opposite, falsity of evil.
He shall pay silver () = other truth consenting in its place. Explained.
If thou shalt lend silver () = instruction. Explained.
Idols of silver = falsities of doctrine.
40 bases of silver () = plenary support through truth.
Hooks... and fillets of silver () = modes of conjunction through truth.
Silver = falsity.
Silver and gold from Tarshish () = scientific truth and good.
Silver = the truth which is of intelligence.
The silver of expiations () = truths from good purifying.
Silver = interior and exterior truth.
Silver = spiritual good, which in its essence is truth. HH 115:end.
Idols of silver = worship of what is false in both doctrine and life.
Leaves as of silver.
Great purses full of silver seen, open, as if anyone might take of the silver. Explained.
Idols of silver () = falsities about spiritual things.
Silver (as a metal) corresponds to truths of wisdom.
Tables of silver in that palace.
Dishes and plates of silver there.
Linen stockings with silver threads interwoven.
The vine leaves became silvern.
[155a]. A white dove whose wings shone as from silver.
Silver, sapphire, and vine, = spiritual good, which is the good of the Middle Heaven.
Silver conveyed into my pocket.
While they acknowledge three Persons, their breastplate is silvern.
A sword with a silvern hilt is also given them.
Silver, in the Word, = the truth (of celestial good) which is spiritual good.
Silver = the truth (of the internal man). Illustrated.
To buy fields with silver () = to procure for one's self the good of the Church through truths.
Silver in thy treasuries = Knowledges of truth.
Silver () = truth from good.
Silver () = truth.
Silver () = the truth of the Church. AE 357:17. AE 710:24.
Silver, in the opposite, = falsity (from the evil of the love of self). Illustrated.
Silver = the truth which is from the Lord.
Wings of a dove covered with silver () = spiritual truths.
To be redeemed not by silver () = that they cannot be emancipated from the falsities of evil through truth.
Silver () = the truth of (spiritual) good.
My silver and My gold () = the truths and goods of the Word.
Plates of silver () = the truths of the Church. AE 627:13.
Silver () = truth from good.
Silver () = truth (from the Word).
Their silver () = what is from Own intelligence.
Things from the sense of the letter applied to themselves and their loves only, are called dross of silver (); for silver = the truth of the Word...
Beaten out silver from Tarshish () = the truths of the Word in the sense of the letter. AE 587:6.
A silvern idol = (false doctrine confirmed by the spiritual truth of the Word).
He casteth chains of silver () = that falsities may cohere and appear as truths.
He that hath no silver () = that has no truth of good.
Without silver = without truth from proprium or Own intelligence.
What is desirable in silver () = Knowledges of truth. AE 799:14.
Silver cast into the streets () = falsities rejected. AE 827:5.
The silver found with those who dwell below these Heavens is given by the Lord from the Spiritual Heaven; for silver corresponds to spiritual good, which in its essence is truth.
Silver (corresponds to) spiritual truth.
There are fruits and seeds... in the Middle Heaven of silver.
Silvern things correspond to the affections of the Second Heaven.
The spiritual state of the Church as to the truth of wisdom, is described by silver.
